task: Fix Koala CLI lifecycle self-locks where Koala-generated delivery/summary metadata blocks DONE, convergence crashes on derived symlink loops, and session_brief can recommend DONE while scope is blocking.
outcome:
> koala session_brief
Scope gate: blocking — unresolved out-of-scope files: unexpected.txt
Next step: fix the diff or acknowledge scope in DEV/REVIEW; DONE is not recommended while scope is blocking.

> koala convergence_check
{ "converged": true, "checks": [...] }

> koala story_advance --phase=DONE
Story B-xxxx advanced to DONE without rolling back only because delivery-check.json and summary.json were Koala-generated lifecycle artifacts with command provenance.
facts: B-1261 in the Mac project exposed a real Koala CLI lifecycle self-lock: delivery_check_set and summary_set create required DONE artifacts in TEST, then scope gate can reject those same files as out-of-scope while scope_contract_acknowledge is unavailable in TEST.
scope_contract_acknowledge is intentionally limited to DEV/REVIEW and must not be broadly opened in TEST, otherwise Agent-created product scope expansion could bypass review discipline.
convergence_check currently can traverse derived SwiftPM .build content and fail with ELOOP on GRDB CustomSQLite symlink loops instead of returning a normal convergence report.
session_brief must prioritize blocking scope failures over generic phase-advance hints, otherwise agents are nudged into repeatedly trying DONE despite a known blocker.
Orchestrate owns the Koala CLI implementation; the Mac repo story B-3f23 was discarded because it was the wrong source repository.
constraints: Only Koala command-generated lifecycle metadata may receive restricted automatic acknowledgement; product source, arbitrary JSON, and unknown files must still fail scope unless explicitly acknowledged in DEV/REVIEW.
Do not edit docs/story or tests/fixtures directly; use Koala CLI and fixture tooling where required.
Keep the fix small and mechanical: central policy/helper, command provenance, scanner ignore/symlink safety, session_brief next-step priority, and regression tests.
Preserve existing review, delivery, summary, process fact registry, and dirty gate semantics unless this story explicitly changes them.
Existing unrelated B-META audit working tree changes in main are not part of this story.
